_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score has moved ±2+ points in 0 of 34 windows (0%) over 7 days — this is a locked coil and HOLD is the only statistically honest call; a directional break requires the analyst's explicit breaker conditions to fire first.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst nominally says LONG but self-invalidates with 0-for-34 base rate; narrative says LONG via accumulation framing at 0.77 confidence; the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) and his own evidence against forcing direction tilts consensus to HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: etf_flows sustains >90 AND btc_momentum_30d crosses 55 within 2-3 12h windows, with exchange_netflow dropping below 40 (accumulation signature)
next_move.invalidated_if: vix spikes above 85 OR fed_liquidity lifts off 0 OR btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 80 (sudden inflow/capitulation warning)
